reviews.title: Needs work, great idea, but a ways to go
reviews.text: 1. Listening to music while check-in 2.Needs to be a way to change your order of photos (side tricep right is missing), but what if I want to add more poses and don’t want to have to go back and touch my phone? Like I do abs and thighs, then most muscular, but 2 most muscular poses, then I do Arnold pose, but no way to have it automatically do those poses. 3 Needs a better way to save photos without having to back them all up. You can save each photo one by one, but if I want to save a whole session, no easy way to do that.
reviews.author: pats_fan_4_ever
